hypotheses.proposition: Some followed-asset developments require interpreting revisions or conflicting information.
hypotheses.limitation: Frequency and unresolved burden in intended users remain unknown.
hypotheses.disconfirmation_condition: Recent artifact-backed tasks show no unresolved confusion or the official route solves it easily.

hypotheses.proposition: A relevant measured change joined to official evidence improves on notification alone.
hypotheses.limitation: KAP already advertises following and instant notifications.
hypotheses.disconfirmation_condition: Correct task completion, effort or useful context is no better than the actual next-best route.

hypotheses.proposition: Comparable dated fund explanations can improve monitoring.
hypotheses.limitation: Latest detail is not historical availability; flow residual is not identified cash.
hypotheses.disconfirmation_condition: Existing bank/TEFAS/fund-document routine is equally useful, or delayed facts create false urgency.

hypotheses.proposition: Cross-market and chain context makes an investigation more useful.
hypotheses.limitation: Ownership, sale and cause cannot be inferred from a transfer; actual multi-market workflow unknown.
hypotheses.disconfirmation_condition: Joined evidence is irrelevant, ambiguous, stale or costs more effort than separate tools.

hypotheses.limitation: Constructed policy checks are not Turkish comprehension or truth validation.
hypotheses.disconfirmation_condition: Confidence increases without better source/time comprehension or factual accuracy.

hypotheses.proposition: The verification job recurs enough for ordinary-use retention.
hypotheses.limitation: Platform publications and selected crises do not measure user tasks per week.
hypotheses.disconfirmation_condition: Participants rarely have tasks, mute alerts or return only during exceptional episodes.

hypotheses.proposition: Enough intended users will pay for measured verification value.
hypotheses.limitation: No market-cohort sum, asset total, affected-investor count or stated interest supplies paid demand.
hypotheses.disconfirmation_condition: A subsequently authorized explicit offer loses to actual alternatives or viable cumulative cost cannot be met.

hypotheses.proposition: Published anomaly rates can predict this catalog or user alert frequency.
hypotheses.limitation: Definitions, populations, clocks and units differ; all28 project rates remain unknown.
hypotheses.disconfirmation_condition: Not a product hypothesis to promote: only an admitted complete dataset with frozen rules can establish a project rate.
